content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a change in the structure of the JSON response returned by the SpellCheckComponent, where suggestions were returned as a JSON object instead of a list. This change led to issues in the way the suggestions were accessed and validated in the tests, resulting in failures when the expected format did not match the actual output. The patch reverts this change to restore the previous behavior, ensuring that suggestions are returned as a list, which aligns with the existing test cases and expected output format.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: "fq", "id:[0 TO 9]", /*returns 10, less selective */ "fq", "lowerfilt:th*", /* returns 8, most selective */
